origin.summary: Workout 5 of the 2014 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A six-step descending couplet (21 down to 3, by threes) of thrusters and burpees — a longer version of Fran's ladder logic.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2014/5 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
